cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle three-quarter shot of cute 2.5-head chibi SD characters on pure #FFFFFF background. On the left, Gnome Rogue with daggers sheathed at her waist excitedly holds up a glowing leather belt in both hands. Beside her on the right, Tauren Druid leans in with sparkling eyes next to a defeated cute 2.5-head chibi SD mechanical trogg boss lying dizzy on minimal Gnomeregan floor tiles.

cuts.speaker: 타우렌 드루이드
cuts.dialogue:
우와, 야드랑 도적 둘 다
딱 맞는 옵션이잖아?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Medium side-profile shot on pure #FFFFFF background of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue on the left (daggers sheathed) and Tauren Druid on the right huddling closely together over the glowing leather belt, completely absorbed in inspecting it. Small cartoon dust clouds and tiny pebbles drop silently from the top edge onto their heads.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
야! 템 구경 그만해!
천장 무너진다니까?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Dynamic low-angle shot on pure #FFFFFF background looking up past cute 2.5-head chibi SD Orc Warrior on the left, wielding a one-handed axe and sturdy shield while shouting upward in panic. On the right, cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest holds her golden cross staff and blinks calmly at falling pebbles and crack lines overhead.

Dutch-tilt big bust-up close-up filling 80 percent of frame height on pure #FFFFFF background of cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue on the left and Tauren Druid on the right frozen in exaggerated comic terror. Both have huge wide eyes, sweat drops, and gaping mouths looking straight up as a massive dark cartoon boulder shadow engulfs them from above.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
다 같이 돌에 깔려서
전멸이 이게 말이 되냐…
cuts.visual_prompt: Ground-level comedic shot on pure #FFFFFF background centered on a giant pile of cute 2.5-head chibi SD cartoon cave boulders. On the left side of the rubble, Orc Warrior's flattened head and shield poke out with dizzy swirling stars above her, while Tauren Druid's tiny hooves stick helplessly out from under the rocks on the right.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
허리띠 구경 잘했으니
이제 무덤에서 걸어오시죠.
cuts.visual_prompt: Three-quarter shot on pure #FFFFFF background of translucent pale-blue ghostly cute 2.5-head chibi SD Gnome Rogue slumped dejectedly on the left with a glowing wispy spirit tail (strictly zero halo or ring above head). On the right, translucent pale-blue ghostly cute 2.5-head chibi SD Night Elf Priest floats with a wispy ghost tail leaning casually on her golden cross staff with an icy deadpan half-smile (strictly zero halo, zero ring, zero wings above head).
